notes: The initial seven-case pilot is preserved at the discovery root. Its neutral CSV prompt lacked explicit authorization for later external collaboration; it remains evidence of that wording only. The original explicit case self-reported skill use without a successful full-body tool read. The original project case did return the full project Skill and AGENTS.md bodies, but Codex -C pointed to the external session directory, so it does not establish native project-scope discovery; the initial path matcher also missed escaped Windows separators. Corrected cases below require actual full-body tool results, and the project case runs with -C at the project root. No original logs are overwritten.
